panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 4 panels (A, B, C, D). A: Gross ovarian specimen from a patient with Krukenberg tumor by gallbladder cancer; caption describes cystic formations with smooth surfaces filled with mucus, a real patient manifestation but not matching a provided vocabulary finding. B: Low-power H&E histology of ovarian tissue from the patient; caption describes dilated glands of different sizes with well-differentiated architecture, supporting ovarian metastasis in Krukenberg tumor. C: High-power H&E histology of ovarian tissue from the patient; caption describes the same dilated glandular architecture and loose ovarian stroma seen in the Krukenberg tumor specimen. D: Immunohistochemical staining of the ovarian metastasis shows strong CK19 cytoplasmic positivity in glandular epithelium, compatible with pancreatic-biliary metastatic neoplasm in the reported Krukenberg tumor.
